assumptions.choice: Market entries and mean-reversion exits execute according to Backtrader's normal market-order timing; protective stops are submitted from notify_order after the entry fill.
assumptions.reason: The specification requires market and stop orders but does not override Backtrader order-execution semantics.

assumptions.choice: A protective stop is cancelled when a mean-reversion exit is submitted or completed; a new stop is created after any later entry fill.
assumptions.reason: This implements cancellation/replacement of the protective stop when the position is closed.
